protocol.title: Computer Vision Reveals Hidden Variables Underlying NF-kB Activation in Single Cells
protocol.platform: High-throughput microfluidic live-cell imaging (PDMS chip) + image-based SVM machine learning
cell_lines: NIH 3T3 mouse fibroblasts (p65(-/-) knockout, re-engineered with p65-dsRed / H2B-GFP)
protocol.objective: Microfluidic live-cell imaging of NF-kB (p65) nuclear translocation in single cells under TNF-alpha stimulation; SVM-based prediction of activation from prestimulation images; fixed-cell immunofluorescence validation of IkB/NF-kB ratio as primary determinant of heterogeneous activation probability

device.stimulus_delivery: Pressurized vials at 5 psi; PEEK microbore tubing (VICI) connected to chip
device.image_analysis: Custom MATLAB scripts; background correction, smooth + z-score normalization, peak detection

p65_dsRed.selection: Minimum fluorescence clone for endogenous expression levels

cell_line_details.notes: Dual-reporter system allows simultaneous tracking of NF-kB dynamics (red) and nuclear morphology (green) in real time

immunofluorescence.fixative: 4% paraformaldehyde in PBS, 10 min at room temperature
immunofluorescence.blocking_permeabilization: 10% BSA + 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS, 1 h at room temperature

steps.name: Fibronectin chamber coating
steps.notes: PDMS microfluidic chambers coated overnight with fibronectin (FC010-10MG) to promote cell adhesion

steps.name: PBS wash of coated chamber
steps.notes: 1-min PBS rinse to remove unbound fibronectin before cell seeding

steps.name: Cell seeding and pre-stimulation culture
steps.notes: Cells cultured for 5 h before stimulation to equilibrate to endogenous p65-dsRed / H2B-GFP expression levels

steps.name: Prestimulation live-cell imaging
top_features: Mean nuclear p65-dsRed fluorescence (r=0.62 with activation probability)
steps.notes: Unperturbed imaging window; provides the feature set for the SVM activation classifier. No reagent mixing occurs at this step; mix abstracts the repeated field-of-view acquisition loop.

steps.name: TNF-alpha stimulation
steps.t_zero: Stimulation marks t=0 for all single-cell trace analyses
steps.notes: TNF-alpha pre-diluted in FluoroBrite DMEM + 2x GlutaMAX + penicillin/streptomycin + FBS; loaded in pressurized vial and delivered via microbore tubing to chip

steps.name: Post-stimulation live-cell imaging
steps.readout: Nuclear NF-kB (p65-dsRed) translocation per cell tracked over 6 h
steps.activation_kinetics: Digital (switch-like) cytoplasm-to-nucleus translocation within ~40 min in responding cells
steps.notes: Custom MATLAB: background correction, smooth + z-score normalization, peak detection. Cells show either complete p65 translocation or no translocation (bimodal / digital response).

steps.name: NF-kB activation QC detection
steps.notes: Module abstracts MATLAB image analysis pipeline: nuclear segmentation, mean nuclear fluorescence extraction, peak height computation, binary label assignment

steps.name: PBS rinse before fixation
steps.notes: 1-min PBS rinse to remove culture medium before paraformaldehyde fixation

steps.name: Paraformaldehyde fixation
steps.imaging_note: Cell images taken at t=-5 min (immediately before fixation) used for UMAP alignment with live imaging data
steps.notes: Cells fixed for 10 min at room temperature; captures molecular state for IkB-alpha immunofluorescence

steps.name: Blocking and permeabilization
steps.notes: Blocks non-specific antibody binding; Triton X-100 permeabilizes membranes for intracellular IkB-alpha access

steps.name: Primary antibody incubation (IkB-alpha)
steps.target: IkB-alpha (main inhibitor of NF-kB; sequesters p65 in cytoplasm of unstimulated cells)
steps.biological_significance: IkB/NF-kB ratio is the primary molecular determinant of p65 leakiness and activation probability (Fig. 4C; Fig. 5C-D)

steps.name: PBS wash after primary antibody
steps.notes: Removes unbound primary antibody before secondary incubation

steps.name: Secondary antibody incubation (Alexa Fluor 647)
steps.antibody: Goat polyclonal anti-rabbit IgG H&L Alexa Fluor 647 (G378361)
steps.notes: Enables quantification of IkB-alpha protein levels in nuclear and cytoplasmic compartments for IkB/NF-kB ratio analysis

steps.name: Immunofluorescence staining QC detection
steps.readout: Nuclear and cytoplasmic IkB-alpha (AF647) + p65-dsRed quantification; IkB/NF-kB ratio per cell

machine_learning.cross_validation: 10-fold; 8 train, 1 validation, 1 test per run; 10% dropout
machine_learning.feature_extraction: Hand-crafted; custom MATLAB scripts; nuclear segmentation per tracked cell

top_predictor.feature: Mean nuclear p65-dsRed fluorescence at t=0 (prestimulation)

machine_learning.umap_visualization: 8 top features; cells segregate into TNF-sensitive and TNF-resistant regions

key_findings.primary_predictor: Leaky (prestimulation) nuclear p65-dsRed level is the single best predictor of NF-kB activation (r=0.62)
key_findings.molecular_mechanism: IkB/NF-kB (p65) ratio predetermines p65 leakiness and activation probability; inverse correlation rho=-0.256, P=2.7e-11
key_findings.state_dynamics: Unstimulated cells dynamically transition between molecular states but maintain stable activation probability (autocorrelation r=0.78 at 35 min prestimulation)
key_findings.activation_fraction: 73.71% of cell state transitions remain within or adjacent to the same activation-probability cluster
key_findings.counterintuitive_finding: Cells with high initial IkB require smaller TNF dose for activation; probability depends on IkB/NF-kB ratio, not absolute IkB level
key_findings.leaky_p65_magnitude: Activated cells show ~5-fold higher leaky nuclear p65 than non-responding cells (P=1.35e-13); leakiness is ~12% of total cell fluorescence

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.contents: Fibronectin coat, PBS wash, cell seeding, 5h culture, 90m prestim imaging, TNF stimulation, 360m post-stim imaging, activation QC detect

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_2_t
basic_blocks.action: Full fixed-cell IF pipeline: PBS rinse, PFA fix, block/perm, 1° Ab, PBS wash, 2° Ab, dispose

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.contents: dispose(activationSignal); PBS dispense; IF staining QC detect
